name: upright-row.html
instructions:
1. Stand with feet shoulder-width apart. Grip the barbell with hands about shoulder-width apart, palms facing your thighs.
2. Hold the barbell firmly in front of your thighs. Stand tall, chest up, and shoulders back. This is the starting position.
3. Lift the bar straight up along your body, leading with your elbows. Keep the bar close to your torso.
4. Raise the bar around chest level, with your elbows higher than your wrists.
5. Slowly lower the bar back to the starting position, maintaining control. This is one rep.
6. Perform the desired number of repetitions, focusing on form and controlled movements.
